subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pair of country – name of grassland is correct?

I. Argentina – Pampas

II. Brazil – Steppe
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pampas

 
 
• Pampas grasslands are situated in Argentina.
 
• Found mostly in the interior of the continent.
 
• Temperature varies greatly in winter and summer.
 
• Rainfall can vary from 25-75cm
 
• It doesn't have much diversity in vegetation or animals.
 
• Mostly, horses are found here.
 
 
 
• steppes
 
 
• Grasslands (steppes) are temperate environments, with warm to hot summers and cool to very cold winters; temperatures are often extreme in these midcontinental areas.
 
• They are often located between temperate forests and deserts, and annual precipitation falls between the amounts characteristic of those zones.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Temperate grasslands around the world-

 
 
• Pustaz - Hungary 
 
• Prairies - North America 
 
• Pampas - Argentina and Uruguay 
 
• Veld - South Africa
 
• Downs - Australia
 
• Canterbury - New Zealand
 
• Steppe - Russia
